Question: For a science project, Sammy observed a chipmunk and a squirrel stashing acorns in holes. The chipmunk hid \(3\) acorns in each of the holes it dug. The squirrel hid \(4\) acorns in each of the holes it dug. They each hid the same number of acorns, although the squirrel needed \(4\) fewer holes. How many acorns did the chipmunk hide?
